- Next step: workspace release build -> `opblob seal-shm` + `persist` -> `sudo ./deploy.sh --system` (send/receive into slot B, overlay swap, base-file manifest, then graceful runit REBOOT).
- Incus persistent storage for the Cozo spaces = loop image /var/lib/incus/disks/3tched.img (Incus pool `3tched`, btrfs FSID a1ab7b42…; kernel guard trusts cgroup /opdbus-incus for that FSID only). The image lives in btrfs subvolume @incus (id 275) on the root fs, currently mounted at /var/lib/incus/disks.
- /etc/fstab was edited 2026-10-26 18:38 and lost `UUID=d53eeac0-949b-499c-b051-9fecf8678f59 /var/lib/incus/disks btrfs defaults,subvol=@incus 0 0`, but kept the dependent `/var/lib/incus/disks/3tched.img /var/lib/incus/storage-pools/3tched-pool btrfs rw,loop,subvolid=5,x-mount.mkdir 0 0`. Compare /etc/fstab.before-leaf-pool-20261019 vs /etc/fstab. Other Oct 26 changes (vectors moved to /run/mounts/vectors; seed/ct-upgrade/cdrom/noauto FUSE lines removed) appear deliberate — owner says he unmounted things mounted in wrong places.
- Pool filesystem currently not mounted at storage-pools/3tched-pool (loop0 still attached). Incus runit service is down/restart-looping because its run script waits for kernel-guard readiness.
- Kernel guard is OFF: owner unmounted bpffs /sys/fs/bpf, which dropped all 8 pins (/sys/fs/bpf/opdbus-btrfs-guard/{settings,scope,trusted,counters,native_link,compat_link,rmdir_link,rename_link}); links detached. Its runit run script re-loads on start but refuses if trusted cgroups (/opdbus-storage, /opdbus-release, /opdbus-incus) are occupied; a reboot gives a clean initial load.
- Slot A declares 9 overlay targets; only 4 mounted (owner unmounted 5): /opt/opdbus, /opt/op-dbus/execution-python, /usr/share/op-dbus, /usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/helpers, /usr/local/share/op-dbus/dashboard-release. Release status still says readiness complete.
- Two pairs of 3tched-fs FUSE processes exist (runit 10:38 Oct 26 `--store` form, and sudo 21:08 `--view` form) for the two mounts /run/mounts/3tchedFS and /run/mounts/threetched.
- AGENTS.md: identity storage must never be added/removed outside explicit creation; do not route around the guard.

Questions:
1. Should the @incus fstab line be restored BEFORE the --system deploy/reboot, or should mounting be done manually AFTER? Consider durability across future reboots, guard trust binding by FSID, the incus run script's guard dependency, and any risk to the Cozo spaces.
2. Does the guard being OFF, the 5 unmounted slot-A targets, or the duplicate 3tched-fs pair need handling BEFORE the deploy (e.g. could deploy.sh / op-release-launch refuse or misbehave with slot A's readiness record not matching mounts)? Inspect deploy.sh, deploy/release/op-release-launch and relevant source read-only.
3. Give an ordered checklist: pre-deploy actions (if any), deploy, post-reboot verification (guard 8 pins + GLOBAL ready, pool FSID a1ab7b42 mounted, incus up, all slot-B targets mounted, FUSE mounts single pair).

</file>
